symptom: PC-A in VLAN 10 cannot reach another PC in VLAN 10; link is up.
topology_note: PC-A connected to SW1 Fa0/3; Fa0/3 should be an access port in VLAN 10.
show_outputs:
show vlan brief
Fa0/3 listed under VLAN 20
expected_fault: PC-A access port assigned to VLAN 20 instead of VLAN 10

symptom: PC-B has an IP address but cannot communicate with VLAN 20 hosts.
topology_note: SW1 and SW2 use VLAN 20; VLAN 20 must exist on both switches.
show_outputs:
show vlan brief
VLAN 20 not present on SW2
expected_fault: VLAN 20 is missing on SW2

symptom: Devices in VLAN 10 across two switches cannot communicate.
topology_note: SW1-SW2 link is Gi0/1 and must operate as a trunk.
show_outputs:
show interfaces trunk
No Gi0/1 entry
show interfaces Gi0/1 switchport
Administrative Mode: static access
expected_fault: Inter-switch link is operating as an access port instead of trunk

symptom: VLAN 30 hosts work locally but fail across SW1-SW2.
topology_note: VLAN 30 must be allowed on the trunk.
show_outputs:
show interfaces trunk
Port Gi0/1 allowed VLANs: 10,20
expected_fault: VLAN 30 is not allowed on the trunk

symptom: Printer connected to Fa0/8 gets connectivity to the wrong subnet.
topology_note: Printer belongs to VLAN 30.
show_outputs:
show vlan brief
Fa0/8 listed under VLAN 10
expected_fault: Printer access port is assigned to VLAN 10 instead of VLAN 30

symptom: PC cannot reach gateway; switch port LED is off.
topology_note: PC-A is connected to SW1 Fa0/5; port should be enabled.
show_outputs:
show interfaces status
Fa0/5 disabled
expected_fault: Interface Fa0/5 is administratively down

symptom: PC can ping its gateway but cannot reach the intended server subnet.
topology_note: PC should use 192.168.10.25/24 in VLAN 10.
show_outputs:
ipconfig
IPv4 Address: 192.168.20.25
Mask: 255.255.255.0
Gateway: 192.168.20.1
expected_fault: PC has an address from the wrong subnet/VLAN

symptom: PC can reach some hosts but cannot correctly route to remote networks.
expected_fault: PC uses an incorrect subnet mask

symptom: PC can communicate with same-subnet hosts but not remote server.
topology_note: VLAN 10 gateway is 192.168.10.1.
expected_fault: Default gateway does not belong to the PC's subnet

symptom: Two PCs intermittently lose connectivity and ARP behavior is inconsistent.
topology_note: PC-A and PC-B should have unique addresses.
show_outputs:
show ip arp
192.168.10.25 mapped to changing MAC addresses
PC-A: 192.168.10.25
PC-B: 192.168.10.25
expected_fault: Duplicate IP address exists on two devices

symptom: LAN-A can reach its router but cannot reach LAN-B.
topology_note: R1 must route 192.168.20.0/24 through R2.
show_outputs:
show ip route
No entry for 192.168.20.0/24
expected_fault: Required static route to LAN-B is missing

symptom: R1 sends traffic for LAN-B toward the wrong next hop.
topology_note: R2 next hop is 10.0.0.2.
show_outputs:
show ip route 192.168.20.0
Routing entry for 192.168.20.0/24
via 10.0.0.3
expected_fault: Static route uses an incorrect next-hop address

symptom: R1 and R2 do not form an OSPF adjacency.
topology_note: Both routers should use OSPF area 0 on the 10.0.0.0/30 link.
show_outputs:
show ip ospf neighbor
No neighbors
show ip ospf interface Gi0/0
Area 1
expected_fault: OSPF area mismatch prevents adjacency

symptom: Router interfaces are up but remote LAN is absent from routing table.
topology_note: R1 LAN 192.168.10.0/24 must be advertised in OSPF.
show_outputs:
show ip protocols
Routing for Networks:
10.0.0.0/30
192.168.10.0/24 absent
expected_fault: LAN network is not included in OSPF configuration

symptom: PC receives an APIPA address and cannot reach the network.
topology_note: Router should provide DHCP for 192.168.10.0/24.
show_outputs:
show ip dhcp pool
No pool named VLAN10
ipconfig
169.254.10.20
expected_fault: DHCP pool for VLAN 10 is missing

symptom: Clients fail to receive addresses even though DHCP service is enabled.
topology_note: Pool is 192.168.10.0/24; only gateway and server addresses should be excluded.
show_outputs:
show ip dhcp pool VLAN10
Network: 192.168.10.0/24
Leased addresses: 0
show run | include ip dhcp excluded-address
192.168.10.1 192.168.10.254
expected_fault: Almost the entire DHCP range is excluded

symptom: PC receives an IP but cannot reach remote networks.
topology_note: VLAN 20 gateway is 192.168.20.1.
show_outputs:
show ip dhcp pool VLAN20
Default-router 192.168.10.1
expected_fault: DHCP supplies the wrong default gateway

symptom: PC can ping a server by IP but cannot open it by hostname.
topology_note: DNS server is 192.168.10.10.
show_outputs:
ipconfig /all
DNS Server: 192.168.20.10
ping 192.168.10.10
Reply received
expected_fault: PC is configured with the wrong DNS server address

symptom: PC reaches DNS server but hostname resolution fails.
topology_note: DNS server should contain an A record for server.lab.local.
show_outputs:
nslookup server.lab.local
*** Non-existent domain
expected_fault: Required DNS record is missing

symptom: PC can reach gateway but cannot reach web server on TCP 80.
topology_note: ACL should permit VLAN 10 to the server subnet.
expected_fault: ACL explicitly denies HTTP traffic

symptom: ACL is intended to protect the server network but users lose access unexpectedly.
topology_note: ACL should be applied inbound on the external interface.
show_outputs:
show run interface Gi0/1
ip access-group 110 out
expected_fault: ACL is applied in the wrong direction

symptom: Internal clients are blocked although ACL should only filter guest traffic.
topology_note: ACL 120 is for guest VLAN traffic.
show_outputs:
show run | include access-group
interface Gi0/0
 ip access-group 120 in
interface Gi0/1
 no ip access-group 120
expected_fault: Guest ACL is applied to the internal-facing interface

symptom: Inside PC can reach router but cannot access an outside server.
topology_note: Inside LAN 192.168.10.0/24 must be translated on R1.
show_outputs:
show ip nat translations
Pro Inside global: none
show run | include ip nat inside
No inside interface configured
expected_fault: NAT configuration is missing

symptom: Inside clients have no usable translations.
topology_note: Inside LAN is 192.168.10.0/24.
show_outputs:
show access-lists 1
10 permit 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255
show ip nat translations
No translations
expected_fault: NAT ACL matches the wrong source network

symptom: Multiple inside PCs need Internet access but only one host works.
topology_note: PAT/NAT overload should use the outside interface address.
show_outputs:
show run | include ip nat inside source
ip nat inside source list 1 pool PUBLIC
show ip nat statistics
Overload: disabled
expected_fault: NAT is configured without overload/PAT for multiple clients

symptom: Laptop sees the AP but cannot associate.
topology_note: SSID should be CampusWiFi and WPA2 key must match the configured key.
show_outputs:
Packet Tracer wireless settings
SSID: GuestWiFi
Security: WPA2
AP SSID: CampusWiFi
expected_fault: Client is configured with the wrong SSID

symptom: Wireless client associates successfully but gets an address from the wrong subnet.
topology_note: Corporate SSID should map to VLAN 20.
show_outputs:
show vlan brief
VLAN 10 active
show interfaces trunk
VLAN 20 not allowed
expected_fault: Wireless VLAN is not correctly mapped/allowed

symptom: Guest Wi-Fi can reach an internal database server.
topology_note: Guest VLAN 50 must not access internal VLAN 10.
show_outputs:
show access-lists GUEST
No deny for 192.168.50.0 to 192.168.10.0
ping 192.168.10.50
Reply received
expected_fault: Guest isolation ACL is missing or incomplete

symptom: PC gets IP and gateway ping works, but cannot reach a server in another VLAN.
topology_note: Router-on-a-stick uses Gi0/0 subinterfaces for VLANs 10 and 30.
show_outputs:
show interfaces trunk
Gi0/1 trunking
show run interface Gi0/0.30
No encapsulation dot1Q 30
expected_fault: VLAN 30 router subinterface is missing or incorrectly configured

topology_note: PC should be in VLAN 30, use 192.168.30.0/24, and reach gateway 192.168.30.1.
show_outputs:
show vlan brief
Fa0/12 in VLAN 20
ipconfig
169.254.30.5
show ip interface brief
Gi0/0.30 administratively down
